baseline.title: Project Y & Continuous Release
baseline.summary: Ahmad Al-Dahle (ex-Meta Generative AI) joined as CTO in January 2026, spearheading Project Y — an hourly release cycle to drive booking conversion. He asserts "the era of software engineering as primarily a code-writing discipline is ending," advocating systems thinking over syntax fluency.
baseline.cursorAngle: Agent-first Composer aligns directly with Al-Dahle's shift from syntax writing to systems architecture.

baseline.title: 10% YoY Developer Satisfaction Gain
baseline.summary: VP of Developer Productivity restructured the platform org from tool-focused to problem-focused. Two pillars — platform-agnostic shared tooling and platform-specific iOS/Android/Web teams — achieved a 10% year-over-year increase in developer satisfaction via paved paths and AirDev cloud environments.
baseline.cursorAngle: Cursor's remote SSH + yak integration delivers on "make common easy and uncommon possible."

baseline.title: Ready for the Next Paradigm
baseline.summary: Sulkina drove 70% weekly active Copilot adoption but notes the bottleneck: "Chat is great but we can reach for more." She's actively searching for AI-native tools — not another sidebar — exactly what Cursor delivers.
baseline.cursorAngle: Replace bolted-on sidebars with an AI-native IDE built for agentic workflows.

baseline.title: Margin Defense & New Lines
baseline.summary: Defending 35%+ Adjusted EBITDA while launching boutique hotels, Host Services Marketplace, and navigating municipal compliance in NYC and Barcelona. Speed without sacrificing platform stability is the defining engineering challenge.
baseline.cursorAngle: Coinbase's 90%+ TTM reduction proves agent-first delivery without sacrificing quality.
